items.description:
Rent a Girlfriend Author Reiji Miyajima can't help but suffer from success. To Season 4 getting announced, a game announcement for Nintendo Switch and now his other manga getting an anime by Doga Kobo. Its a wild time to be a Rent a Girlfriend fan.

Love you all so much thank you for all the support
